description:
[0.98a] BANISHED IMPERIUM 1.1.1

After spending a century in isolation due to a terrible warp storm, Tesalia, sector capital, finds itself free in a strange corner of the galaxy; full of non-imperial human civilizations ripe for conquest, strange technologies, and no knowledge of the God Emperor. The Imperial Navy sallies forth to rectify this situation.

This mod adds the Imperium of Man from Warhammer 40.000 as a fully functional NPC faction with its own system, 12 new spaceships and 9 new weapons.

DOWNLOAD

SHIPS

Spoiler

WEAPONS

Spoiler

SCREENSHOTS

Spoiler

COMPATIBILITY

I will be honest, i havent really checked if this is compatible with giant mods like say, Nexerelin. I have 0 clue if it will work with that, and its not something i plan to look into any time soon. But it should be fine with other faction mods (like Orky Sector).

NOTES

Future plans and hopes for this mod include: new ships, a station, new subfactions with a few unique ships and gear (mechanicus, space marines), and hopefully missions and colony threats (these are more unlikely due to my near zero knowledge of coding). When, i have no clue.
Some of the art in this mod is a placeholder taken from GW material, notably the portraits and some planetary art. I would like to also make my own art for these elements, but its not something i have practice in, so when is also unkown.

The mod should hopefully be balanced, as many stats are based on vanilla stuff. I have been able to beat most vanilla enemies with fleets using mostly the contents of this mod, without making late game enemies trivial. I greatly appreciate any feedback on mod balance, art, suggestions, etc.

Many, many thanks to the great folk of the Unofficial Starsector Discord modding channels, without whose help this mod would not have been possible.

GW please dont nuke me from orbit its just some silly pixel art

changelog.1.1.1:
only bugfixes and small changes in this one
 -Increased the price of Saturnine Drive item to 100.000.
 -Increased the price of the Incomparable class battlecruiser to 225.000 (previously it costed the same as a normal cruiser. Combined with the previous change, the cost of purchasing/upgrading any sort of imperial battlecruiser is now the same)
 -Added the Mars and Hecutor macrocannons to the blueprint package. This should also fix pirate fleets from using Tyrants armed with nothing but mining lasers, among other silly stuff. If in your playthrough you have already learned the imperial blueprint package, you will have to do so again to get the blueprints of these two weapons.
 -Auto-assign weapons groups will now give prow torpedos the "linked" fire mode by default
 -Fixed Battlecruiser Conversion not adding the dorsal lances on npc fleets.
 -Reduced the reload time of titanforge lances by 1 second (overall firepower is the same). The long reload time was making ships like the Lunar wobble when firing their broadsides.
 -Added a small flat range bonus to Ship of the Line to account for the range penalty imposed on the broadsiders due to how far their broadside weapon slots are from their shield.
changelog.1.1.0:
New
 Ships
-Retribution class battleship
-Incomparable class battlecruiser
-Tyrant class cruiser
 Hullmods
Battlecruiser Conversion
-Allows you to upgrade the Lunar and Tyrant to battlecruisers (Armaggedon and Overlord). Requires Saturnine Pattern Drive to install, a new item avaliable for purchase in Kalassos and Sulfurus
 Weapons & Wings
Hecutor plasma macrocannon
Starwolf torpedo bomber
 Changes
 Ships
Lunar
-DP cost reduced to 22
-Speed reduced to 60
-Adjusted firing arcs
 Emperor
-Increased cargo and fuel capacity
-Speed decreased to 25
-Adjusted firing arcs
 Dauntless
-Flux capacity set to 8000
-Flux dissipation increased to 500
-Armor increased to 800
 Thunderbolt
-Added Rugged Construction (i cant stop them from dying so i surrender)
 Hullmods
Ship of the Line
-Increased range bonus to 200. (This means the mars macrocannon and lance now match range at 800 on a lunar, so you likely wont need advanced optics)
-Adjusted the medium mount cost reduction from 4 to 2 OP, as was intended. (you will probably have to adjust your loadouts a bit)
-New sprite
 Weapons
Titanforge Lance
-Resprited lance.
-Turned into triple beam weapon (the performance is still broadly the same).
 Mars macrocannon
-Reduced range to 600 (with the change to Ship of the line, final range on cruisers and battleships is unchanged)
-Decrease in accuracy, now smaller ships should have a better chance against a gun that can defeat their shields and get through their light armor
 Bombardment cannon
-Reduced reload to 2 seconds
-Increased damage to 220
 Misc
Added the ships of the Gothic war to the ship names list, ensured the faction doesnt use vanilla ship names (some fitted, many did not).
Added more portraits from the BFG rulebook, and i found cleaner versions
Minor changes to descriptions
